item.description:
Release v5.23.1

Changes since v5.23.0

  • feat(PluginAppIconDesigner): contribute app-icon-designer skill
  • feat(PluginAppStorePromoDesigner): contribute app-store-promo-designer skill
  • feat(PluginGit): contribute Git skill via SkillProviding
  • feat(PluginLLMProviderTencent): add GLM-5-Turbo model
  • feat(PluginLLMProviderTencent): add kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed model
  • feat(PluginMindMapDesigner): contribute mind-map-designer skill
  • feat(PluginModelSelector): Add model capability filter bar
  • feat(PluginResumeDesigner): contribute resume-designer skill
  • feat(settings): add custom cloud llm providers
  • feat(tencent): add deepseek-v4-flash and hy-mt2-pro models
  • feat(tencent): add deepseek-v4-pro-202606 model to TokenHub provider
  • feat(tencent): add glm-5.1, glm-5, kimi-k2.5, kimi-k2.7-code, deepseek-v3.2, minimax-m2.7 models
  • feat(tencent): add glm-5.2 model to TokenHub provider
  • feat(tencent): add qwen3.5-plus model
  • fix: clear stale messages when switching conversations
  • fix: normalize reused tool call IDs
  • fix: route LLM requests by conversation provider
  • fix: route model selection through conversation capability
  • fix: show Aliyun cache hit rate status
  • fix(chat-toolbar): arrange buttons from left to right
